title: What Is Breast Augmentation Surgery?
description: What breast augmentation (augmentation mammoplasty) is, what it is for and when it is indicated. Care in Lima with price alternatives.
tldr: It increases breast size and improves breast shape using implants or, in some cases, your own fat. The specialist decides the indication; results vary from person to person.
bodyHtml:
It increases breast size and improves breast shape using implants or, in some cases, your own fat.

How is it performed?

Implants are placed (under the muscle or under the breast gland) through discreet incisions; planning is personalized.

When is it indicated?

People who want to increase or reconstruct breast volume and are in adequate health. The surgeon evaluates it.

At Cirugía 24 Horas

We operate in Lima with the same team at different clinics, so you can choose the price alternative that fits you. We also care for patients from abroad.

faqs.q: Is breast augmentation an outpatient procedure?
faqs.a: It depends on the procedure and the clinic; the specialist will tell you after the evaluation.

faqs.q: Who decides whether I need it?
faqs.a: The surgeon, after an evaluation with tests.

People who want to increase or reconstruct breast volume and are in adequate health. The surgeon evaluates it.

title: Risks and Complications of Breast Augmentation
description: Risks and possible complications of breast augmentation and how they are reduced with evaluation and follow-up.
tldr: Like any surgery, breast augmentation has risks: capsular contracture, asymmetry, changes in sensation, infection and the possible need for revision surgery. They are uncommon and are reduced with proper evaluation, careful technique and follow-up. The surgeon explains them during the consultation.
bodyHtml:
Learning about the risks of breast augmentation is part of a responsible decision.

Possible complications

Capsular contracture, asymmetry, changes in sensation, infection and the possible need for revision surgery.

How they are reduced

A complete pre-operative evaluation, careful technique and close follow-up. The team's experience influences the results.

faqs.a: It is a common procedure; safety depends on the evaluation, the technique and the follow-up.

faqs.q: What warning signs should I watch for?
faqs.a: Marked swelling, severe pain, fever or signs of infection.
